page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem provides 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES-NI. The instance is provisioned with 8.0 GB of memory, resulting in a compute-aligned allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with the instance, and it includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-level performance across compute and memory subsystems relative to broader cloud hardware. The instance achieves a single-core score of 1103.19 and a multi-core score of 2934.5 in stress-ng tests, alongside Geekbench results of 987.0 for single-core and 2173.0 for multi-core. PassMark testing yields an overall CPU score of 3628.64, while compression throughput registers at 19.02 GB/sec for single-threaded gzip. Memory bandwidth evaluates to 20.58 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 18.68 GB/sec for writes. In application benchmarks, the server delivers 2.86 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 3.36 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The ecs.c5.xlarge configuration emphasizes dedicated processor thread allocation rather than expansive memory capacity or high-speed local disk I/O. The absence of bundled local storage necessitates network-attached storage volumes for all persistent data requirements. With its 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio and lower-tier benchmark results, the instance is functionally suited for lightweight web serving, microservice hosting, small-scale build environments, and basic utility workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU cores without demanding significant RAM.

The x86_64 system includes support for vector instructions like AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside 35 MB of L3 cache.
